Poser une première pièce dans le donjon: Place a first piece in the computer dungeon. There are plenty left, don't worry.
Le cylindre cannelé que Leibniz présente: The stepped drum Leibniz presented to the Royal Society in 1673 was used in mechanical calculators until the 1970s.
Chasser 3 bugs dans le donjon. Ils revie: Chase 3 bugs out of the dungeon. They'll be back.
Le mot « bug » n'est pas né avec le papi: The word "bug" was not born with the Mark II moth: Edison already used it in 1878. In 1947, "first actual case" shows that the Mark II team already knew the word: the surprise was a real insect.
Switch on the computer at the end of the dungeon. Three centuries of work, and you press a button.
Le premier programme de la Baby de Manch: The Manchester Baby's first program, on June 21, 1948, took 17 instructions. It ran for about 52 minutes to find the largest proper divisor of 262,144: 131,072.
